title: Case Study: TerramEarth — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Predictive Maintenance Pipeline Flow: raw sensor anomaly detection in Bigtable -> BigQuery ML model inference -> automated parts dispatch to local dealership.
routing_rationale: Predictive maintenance bridges real-time telemetry with supply chain logistics, ensuring replacement parts arrive at the dealership before the tractor breaks down.

nodes.label: Turbine RPM Vibration Spike
nodes.detail: Harvester sensor detects abnormal high-frequency vibration in main cutting drum.

nodes.label: BigQuery ML Classification
nodes.detail: Evaluates vibration pattern against 10 years of historical failure telemetry.

nodes.label: Automated SAP Parts Order
nodes.detail: Automatically triggers replacement part shipment from regional warehouse.

nodes.label: Farmer Notification Push
nodes.detail: Alerts farmer via mobile app to bring harvester to dealer before harvest season begins.

steps.title: ML Failure Prediction
steps.action: BQML evaluates live sensor stream against failure patterns; flags 94% failure risk.
steps.why_traversal: Identifies impending failure weeks before human operators can detect symptoms.

steps.title: Autonomous Supply Chain Dispatch
steps.action: ERP system automatically orders parts and sends appointment slot to farmer's mobile phone.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates downtime during critical 14-day annual crop harvest window.

scenarios.label: Model Overfitting Orders Unneeded Parts
scenarios.root_cause: Model was trained on unnormalized data from rocky field terrain; flagged normal bumps as failures.
scenarios.diverted_path: 500 unnecessary parts shipped to rural dealerships.
scenarios.recovery: Retrain model with accelerometer normalization and feature engineering on soil terrain type.
